text_block_list.text: The summer training camp season has arrived once again this year.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa!
Is it true you're making a comeback!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: "Following her victory in the Takarazuka Kinen, Nakayama Festa is set to face off against you in the Japan Cup—"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Well, we're out of time, so...!
Ciao~~!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: "Still, she was in incredible shape... Did you see the way she ran off just now? She's definitely primed and ready...!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't even have time to answer our interviews;
that just shows how serious she is.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: Can you still run? If you can, ten more sets!
Can you still run? If you can, ten more sets!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah... of course I can do it!

Heading into the decisive battle, the Umamusumes' fighting spirits
blazed hotter than the summer itself—
